prompts.narration: You're gripping a shield, screaming down a hillside toward a shieldwall,
prompts.userSummary: Viewer viking charges downhill screaming toward a shieldwall
prompts.prompt:
Flat-color 2D doodle/stickman explainer illustration, 16:9 landscape frame. Uniform thin clean black outlines of identical weight everywhere; flat solid color fills only; no shading, no gradients, no texture, no highlights, no 3D, no photorealism. Every person is a stickman: a perfect circle head with no neck, two small black dot eyes, thin black eyebrows, one curved black mouth line, thin uniform black stick limbs, rounded black mitten hands and feet with no fingers or toes. Clothing is only a flat colored shape on the torso; arms and legs ALWAYS remain thin black stick lines, never filled trouser legs or sleeves; feet are small rounded mitten shapes (may be colored for shoes/boots). Environments use two or three flat color layers only.
A story scene, point-of-view angle, framed as wide charging POV: Viewer viking charges downhill screaming toward a shieldwall — one single frozen moment.
Subjects: The viewer as a Viking raider: a stickman with a light warm beige circle head, short straight dark brown hair with a fringe cut above the ears, wearing a muted forest-green tunic shape on the torso with a dark brown belt line, and small dark brown rounded feet; medium height, neutral adult proportions; carrying a round wooden shield strapped to the left arm. Wearing: A theatrical horned helmet: an oversized stage-costume helmet in darkened brass with huge horns curving up and outward and large round decorative disks where the horns attach. Pose: charging, screaming, gripping shield. Face: eyebrows angled sharply down, wide open-mouth oval, small motion lines.
Setting — a Viking-age hillside battlefield: far background low rolling grey-green hills under a pale grey-blue sky; midground a distant line of round wooden shields forming a shieldwall; foreground a trampled grassy slope. Flat palette: muted moss green, earth brown, pale grey-blue and dull steel grey. Signature objects: round wooden shields and a low grassy hill crest.
Lighting: cool diffused daylight with no strong shadows.
No text anywhere in the image — no letters, numbers, labels, captions, signs, or watermarks.
Avoid: shading, gradients, texture, realistic anatomy, fingers, necks, detailed faces, 3D rendering, painterly or sketchy lines, drop shadows, glow effects, multiple panels unless specified, character reference sheets, turnaround views, and any text not explicitly requested.
